recommended_actions: End all sessions of the account and force a password reset.
Revert unauthorised changes, such as a changed payout number or disabled two-step verification.
Require two-step verification for the account.
If the owner did not make the change: end all sessions, revert the change, reset the password and re-enable two-step verification.
Hold payouts to a newly changed payout number until the owner confirms it.
Consider requiring re-authentication or a confirmation code for these changes.
Block or rate-limit the source IP at the firewall, reverse proxy or application while you investigate.
If any sign-in from the IP succeeded, follow the runbook for PRH-AUTH-003.
For the web app, make sure account lockout or progressive delays and bot checks are enabled on the sign-in form.
limitations: Enrichment not run: IP reputation and location were not considered
Single log source (app-security): no other log corroborates it
Possible benign cause for PRH-ACCT-001: The account owner changing their own settings after signing in
Possible benign cause for PRH-ACCT-001: Support staff helping a user recover an account
Possible benign cause for PRH-AUTH-001: Many users behind one shared NAT or proxy address
Possible benign cause for PRH-AUTH-001: A script or password manager retrying a stale password
Possible benign cause for PRH-AUTH-003: A legitimate user who forgot their password and finally entered it correctly
Possible benign cause for PRH-AUTH-003: Several users behind one shared NAT, some failing and one succeeding
